# EVTX writer fixtures

- `sample.xml` — Winevt event XML used as input by the golden test
  `evtx_writer::tests::golden_output_is_byte_identical` in
  `crates/sigmacatch-regression/src/evtx_writer.rs`.
- `sample.evtx` — golden reference (69 632 bytes) generated by the **baseline pre-refactor writer** (commit `642a60c34`) from `sample.xml` with `record_id = 1`. The golden test asserts the writer output is byte-identical to this file; it is not self-referential.

Regeneration (only when the encoder intentionally changes the byte layout): check out the new reference commit, then regenerate from **inside** the crate — `write_evtx_from_xml` is `pub(crate)` and not callable from outside `sigmacatch-regression`. Add a temporary unit test (or a temporary `#[cfg(test)]` helper) in `crates/sigmacatch-regression/src/evtx_writer.rs` that calls `write_evtx_from_xml(include_str-ish content of sample.xml, 1, path)` with the fixture path pointing at this directory, run it with `cargo test -p sigmacatch-regression`, and replace `sample.evtx` with the produced file. Remove the temporary helper afterwards.

## Regression-data fixtures

- `sigma/`, `sigma_negative/`, `sigma_malformed/`, `sigma_malformed_reference/`
  — minimal committed Sigma roots consumed by the `regression-check` CI job
  (see `sigma/README.md`). The `.gitignore` negations
  (`sigmacatch/tests/fixtures/**/regression_data/`, `**/*.log`) keep them
  tracked despite the repo-wide ignore rules.
